# harborpilot_service_principal (Resource)

A non-human API principal (for automation such as CI or an orchestrator). Issue its tokens with `harborpilot_api_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_service_principal" "ci" {
  name        = "ci"
  description = "CI pipelines"
  permissions = ["config.read", "tokens.manage"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name; changing it creates a new principal.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Granted permissions: `config.read`, `config.write`, `policy.publish`, `secrets.write`, `tokens.manage`, `usage.read`, `activity.read`, `traces.metadata.read`, `traces.delete`, `events.manage`, `notifications.manage`, `compat.manage`, `audit.read`, `users.manage`, `auth.settings`, `system.manage`.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `managed_by` (String)
- `revision` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harborpilot_service_principal.ci <id>
```
